arm.pin_note: release.sha256 is the release.json FILE digest (rails.knowledge_stores._read_pinned hashes the bytes); snapshot.sha256 is the snapshot's CONTENT hash (KnowledgeSnapshot.content_hash(), equal to the release's own snapshot_sha256), never the snapshot.json file digest, which is recorded beside it as snapshot_file_sha256 and pins nothing. The loader checks both identities. S3-5's original cell1-fill-values.json supplied the file digest where the content hash belongs and every cell refused; adv1_to_deltas_steps.py cell1-values now reads the content hash out of release.json and cross-checks it against snapshot.json, so the two cannot be confused again.

prompt_fit_bound.basis: MEASURED on the committed tree by core.flight.cli check (exit 0 on all six cells), whose _assess_prompt_budget bounds each phase by the WORST CASE the supplied stores can render -- not the realised prompt. Cell PLAN's own realised cost over this roster was 8,353.2 prefilled tokens per row over 4.096 contacts. The store's own contribution is small: worst case, in characters of statement text, {"perception": 485, "solver": 938, "reviewer": 423, "planner": 381} (mean statement 84.0 characters, longest 126).
prompt_fit_bound.compaction_is_a_reported_diagnostic: cell PLAN's own sealed run compacted ZERO rows (analysis/SAEA-SLURP-DEFAULT-PLAN-LOCK-PAIRED-ANALYSIS-V1/compaction.json). The four-row smoke reads its own E20 receipts and the verdict carries the compacted-row count per phase beside cell PLAN's 0. A non-zero count is a cost and a caveat on the frontier row's token basis, not a failure.
prompt_fit_bound.decision: ALLOW on perception, reviewer and planner. The SOLVER phase's worst-case bound is COMPACT_REQUIRED by 317 tokens against the live slot minus its one-eighth reserve (24,576 - 3,072). That is a BOUND, not a prediction: it assumes every supplied store renders its cap at its longest on one row. The episode declares context_fit_policy 'compact-or-abstain', so a Solver request that really does exceed the window is COMPACTED, never truncated, and every compaction is counted in the E20 receipts. core.flight.cli check reports no blocker and authorises the cell.

measured_bound_per_phase.smoke_cells: identical to the hundred: reviewer 19,855, planner 19,794, solver 21,820

prompt_fit_bound.no_comparator_bound_was_measurable: the same bound could not be taken for cell PLAN: contracts.gate_exposure refuses core.flight.cli check on a run whose exposure row is consumed ('a consumed run cannot be re-executed'), which is correct and is why the empirical reference above is PLAN's sealed REALISED prefill rather than its bound.
prompt_fit_bound.the_authority_in_flight: core.preparation_fit.build_native_contact_fit_gate fits every realised immutable request against the resident tokenizer before it is transmitted and STOPS the flight rather than truncating. No static bound in this package replaces it.

supply_reach.twin_fixed_points: 16 of 379 twin rows landed on a facet set equal to their own, against 0 under v1. That is arithmetic, not a defect: v1r's vocabulary is 39 distinct intents over 379 rows, so a positional derangement sometimes hands a row an equal attachment, and the builder refuses only a twin that moved nothing at all. The twin is a genuine form control on 363 of 379 rows (95.8 %) and the verdict says so rather than claiming a perfect derangement.
supply_reach.twin_token_matching: The builder holds authored_token_count(twin) == authored_token_count(parent) (5,740), the node distribution exactly (119 / 151 / 95 / 14) and -- new at v1r -- the per-row facet-count multiset, because both derangements move a row's whole attachment as one unit. The v1 caveat that arm and twin could be REACHED at different volumes (arm solver 11 against twin solver 22) is gone: both are 379 of 379. The smoke still measures the per-node supplied item COUNTS on the same four rows and the verdict still reports the realised supplied-token delta rather than assuming it is zero.
supply_reach.what_it_means: Every value of the released store is reachable on every node, arm and twin. The route is therefore NOT inert and the B9a-rec failure mode (18 ACQUIRE rows, 0 items each) is excluded before contact. This is still an UPPER BOUND, not a prediction: a given row supplies only the deltas attached to the at most three intents its own Perception step proposed, capped at 8 / 4 / 4. The smoke's delta-supply acceptance measures the REALISED per-node counts on four rows and a route that serves zero items on every row still stops the arm.
supply_reach.what_this_is: A MODEL-FREE upper bound on what each candidate-bound route can ever select, computed by intersecting each value's associated_facet_ids with the 60 registered SLURP candidate intents of prepared/SAEA-SLURP-NATIVE-CANDIDATE-CONTRACTS-PREPARE-V1/catalog.json. A candidate-bound route matches a value only when one of its facet ids EQUALS one of the row's Perception candidate intent ids. Measured by scripts/flights/batch/adv1_to_deltas_steps.py reach and written into the release-pins document coordination/slurp-stage3-delta-cell-r01-v1/stage3-deltas-v1r-release-pins.json.
